label_definition: bull: forward cumulative return >=threshold AND >=60% future closes above origin; bear symmetric; otherwise mixed/sideways; last h origins unlabelled. Labels end at t+h.
selection: Per horizon maximize equal-fold mean macro-F1 on three validation windows, ties keep first/simpler candidate. Hyperparameters fixed; no selection from test.
test_protocol: Expanding annual refit, every training label ends strictly before Jan1; test origins in year, score only known forward labels. Predictions are at origin close.
test_status: Historical exploratory comparison, not a sealed prospective test; the user has already shown a 2019-2026 chart.
retrospective_policy: 20% directional-change pivots are hindsight descriptions only, with confirmation dates and last leg unconfirmed; never training features or labels.
longest_feature_history: 1250-session moving average with20-session slope =>1270 completed sessions
